head: Moxie RAW photo editor for iPhone Pro comes from a professional colorist
dek: Moxie is a new 4.99 dollar RAW photo editor for iPhone, built around a color engine designed by a professional colorist. It edits only Apple ProRAW photos, so it needs an iPhone Pro or Pro Max.
details: You start from one of its ready-made looks, then adjust exposure, white balance, contrast, saturation, shadows and highlights, with radial and linear masks and film-style grain, diffusion and halation. Edits save as you go and the RAW original stays untouched. It came out on 13 November and was #17 among paid Photo & Video apps on the US App Store on 14 November. It's made by Ryan Callahan, needs iOS 27, and its privacy label says no data is collected.
where: iPhone Pro and Pro Max with ProRAW, iOS 27, 4.99 dollars on the App Store
means: If you shoot ProRAW on an iPhone Pro, Moxie is a one-time purchase editor made for those files; JPEG and HEIF photos won't open in it.
todo: Turn on ProRAW in your iPhone's camera settings before you shoot, since Moxie can't edit other photos. Check the App Store listing before you buy.
